<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_LegoMachine" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/lego-machine">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_LegoMachine" name="Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Start" name="Machine build started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DevelopDesign" name="Develop basic design">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSets" name="Order Lego brick sets">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HandOverSets" name="Give Lego sets to children">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_SortParts" name="Sort parts into containers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BuildMerge" name="Ready to build subcomponent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsCheck" name="Container has parts?" default="Flow_08">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderParts" name="Reorder individual parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_BuildSubcomponent" name="Build subcomponent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_TestSubcomponent" name="Test subcomponent individually">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestResult" name="Test successful?" default="Flow_13">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_AssembleSubcomponent" name="Assemble subcomponent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" name="Redesign and rebuild subcomponent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MoreSubcomponents" name="Further subcomponents remaining?" default="Flow_17">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MachineCompleted" name="Machine completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Start" targetRef="Task_DevelopDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_DevelopDesign" targetRef="Task_OrderSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_OrderSets" targetRef="Task_HandOverSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_HandOverSets" targetRef="ManualTask_SortParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="ManualTask_SortParts" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_BuildMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PartsCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" name="Parts available" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsCheck" targetRef="ManualTask_BuildSubcomponent">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${containerHasParts}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" name="Container empty" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsCheck" targetRef="Task_ReorderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_ReorderParts" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="ManualTask_BuildSubcomponent" targetRef="ManualTask_TestSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="ManualTask_TestSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_TestResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="Test successful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="ManualTask_AssembleSubcomponent">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${testPassed}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="Test not successful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="ManualTask_AssembleSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_MoreSubcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreSubcomponents" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${moreSubcomponents}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreSubcomponents" targetRef="EndEvent_MachineCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
